title: UFO clippings: "Pc Reports 'I Saw 6 Flying Saucers'", "Strange Object Over Mt. Wilson"
description: Two-page spread of pasted newspaper clippings on flying saucers, with headlines including "World Flying Saucer Believers Convene," "2 South African Policemen Report Sighting of 'Saucer'," "It'll be Long Before 'Saucer' Is Forgotten," "Pc Reports 'I Saw 6 Flying Saucers'," "100 Watch UFO," "UN Watch For Saucers Urged" and "Strange Object Over Mt. Wilson." A Wall Street Journal item asks "New 'Fireball' Raises An Old Question: Do Flying Saucers Exist?" The collage includes a small photo, a cartoon of a saucer with a caption about stories, and an editorial cartoon captioned "Repeat Them... Forget It - I Have Enough Credibility Problems As It Is."
